Join @sfscon@mastodon.social 2026, at NOI Techpark in Bolzano, Italy, Nov. 13–14.

With the conference’s support, take in-person, paper-based Linux Professional Institute (LPI) exams free of charge on Nov. 13! 🐧💪 

Seats are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Register now: https://lpi.org/ky7q
